weapons.name: A long named ancestral weapon for the audit
weapons.notes: Complete weapon notes must remain readable in print, including this final sentence.

equip.name: Spell Scroll — Sense
equip.notes: A scroll with the prayer for Sense, reciting the prayer allows the reader to cast the spell.

equip.name: Spell Scroll — Commune
equip.notes: A scroll with the prayer for Commune, reciting the prayer allows the reader to cast the spell.

equip.name: Spell Scroll — Summon
equip.notes: A scroll with the prayer for Summon, reciting the prayer allows the reader to cast the spell.

adv.name: Wealthy
adv.desc: 1 point per rank. Each point grants 2 extra starting koku. Crane/Unicorn/Imperial pay 1 less off the total.

adv.name: Leadership
adv.desc: Once/round, add School Rank +1k1 to an ally’s Initiative Score in a skirmish. Lion pay 5.

adv.name: Kharmic Tie
adv.desc: 1-5 points. Bonded to a chosen person; per point spent, once/session +1k1 on attack rolls made protecting or fighting for them.

adv.name: Blissful Betrothal
adv.desc: A loving arranged marriage lets you buy Gentry, Kharmic Tie (spouse only), Social Position, and Wealth for 2 points less each.

adv.name: Zakyo Toshi Citizen
adv.desc: One extra Rank in a Games Skill you choose; start with half as much again of your School’s starting koku.

disadv.name: Blind
disadv.desc: -3k3 ranged/-1k1 melee attacks; Armor TN from Reflexes+5 only; Water Ring -2 for movement; Perception rolls generally unavailable.

disadv.name: Missing Limb
disadv.desc: +10 TN on any task requiring the missing limb.

disadv.name: Brash
disadv.desc: When threatened or insulted, must pass a Willpower roll (TN 25, +Honor Rank) or attack immediately. Lion pay 4.

disadv.name: Overconfident
disadv.desc: Facing a clearly superior foe, you need a Perception roll (TN 20) to recognize it and disengage instead of pressing on. Lion/Mantis pay 4.

disadv.name: Can’t Lie
disadv.desc: Physically unable to lie; must correct a known lie told in your presence unless you pass a Willpower roll (TN 20).

disadv.name: Contrary
disadv.desc: Compelled to argue your view in disputes; must pass a Willpower roll to hold back. Imperial/courtier pay 4.

disadv.name: Rumormonger
disadv.desc: Compulsive gossip; resisting spreading a rumor needs a Willpower roll scaled to the subject’s Glory. Courtier pay 5.

disadv.name: Soft-Hearted
disadv.desc: Killing another person requires a Willpower roll (TN 20); after a kill, all TNs +10 for a day. Phoenix pay 3.

disadv.name: Lost Love
disadv.desc: Reminders of a lost love raise all your TNs by 5 until you spend a Void Point to refocus (max twice/day).

tech.name: Gaze Into Shadow
tech.desc: [School Technique — Rank 1, Kuni Shugenja] +1k0 on Spell Casting Rolls against non-human creatures; damage spells deal +1k1 against Tainted targets, and gain a Free Raise on any Jade-keyword spell.

tech.name: Sense
tech.desc: [Spell — Universal 1] Detect the presence, rough quantity, and location of elemental spirits of one element nearby.

tech.name: Commune
tech.desc: [Spell — Universal 1] Ask a local elemental spirit questions; it answers honestly (Water/Air/Earth/Fire, not Void).

tech.name: Summon
tech.desc: [Spell — Universal 1] Conjure roughly one cubic foot of the chosen mundane element at range.
